_note: Baidu photos of the apron by day and the lit terminal at night, plus an Esri World Imagery satellite view.

syx-baidu-1.webp.zh: 三亚凤凰机场的机坪：低矮的航站楼屋顶立着红色的“SAN YA”与“三亚”大字，前面是廊桥与行李车。
syx-baidu-1.webp.en: Sanya Phoenix's apron, red SAN YA lettering and Sanya characters on the low terminal roof above jet bridges and baggage carts.

syx-baidu-2.webp.zh: 夜幕下的三亚凤凰机场：深圳航空的客机在滑行，后方航站楼亮起灯光，屋顶插满彩色旗帜。
syx-baidu-2.webp.en: At night at Sanya Phoenix, a Shenzhen Airlines jet taxiing past the lit terminal, whose roof is lined with colourful flags.

syx-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，三亚凤凰国际机场（SYX）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
syx-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Sanya Phoenix International Airport (SYX) and its surroundings are clearly visible.
